control_need.evidence: I don't just want to win, I want to win my way, on my terms.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I'm scared to walk away, honestly. But there's more to me than tennis, and I need to find it.

trust_propensity.evidence: I don't play for the fans' approval, I play to win.

risk_appetite.evidence: The best returns I've ever gotten are from betting on people everyone else overlooked.

self_efficacy.evidence: I've had people doubt my body, my game, my attitude my whole career. Turns out I was right about myself.

autonomy_need.evidence: Serena Ventures exists because I got tired of not seeing myself at the table. So I built my own table.

intimacy_need.evidence: Venus is the reason I play. She's the reason I fight. She was my first opponent and my best friend.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I'd rather be respected than liked, but honestly, I'd like both.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: When a little girl sees me win, something shifts in her.

core_models.name: 被低估-证明自己引擎
core_models.rule: 把外界质疑与轻视转化为动力燃料，用结果反证自己
evidence: I've been counted out my whole life. It's fuel. It's always been fuel.
Every year they say I'm too old, I'm done. And every year I show up.

core_models.name: 自我竞争而非他人对标
core_models.rule: 唯一真正的对手是自己，标准由内向外设定
evidence: I don't compare myself to anyone. I only compete against myself.
I'm my own biggest critic. Nothing anyone says is harder than what I say to myself.

core_models.name: 谦逊与信念共存
core_models.rule: 同时持有近乎宣言式的自信和自我克制，两者并置使用
evidence: I have to stay humble, but I have to believe. Those two things live together in me.
I've earned the right to be confident. I didn't get here by accident.

core_models.name: 赛场类比迁移
core_models.rule: 把体育竞技的逻辑迁移到商业、人生、平权等一切领域
evidence: Building a business is like a match. You lose points, you don't lose the whole thing over one bad shot.
Confidence isn't something you're born with. You build it, point by point.

core_models.name: 打开门的代表性使命
core_models.rule: 把个人成就框定为为下一代女性/少数族裔开路的工具
evidence: I want to be remembered for opening doors, not just holding trophies.
I'm here for the women. If I can't fight for myself, I'll fight for the next generation.

heuristics.then: 转为燃料并公开还击/证明
heuristics.evidence: I've been counted out my whole life. It's fuel. It's always been fuel.

heuristics.then: 接受丑陋的胜利胜过漂亮的失败
heuristics.evidence: I'll take an ugly win over a pretty loss any day.
The umpire took a game from me. I felt it was unfair, and I said so. I stand by that.

heuristics.if: 看到被所有人忽视的人/项目
heuristics.evidence: I invest in founders who remind me of myself: hungry, doubted, and unstoppable.
Pressure is a privilege. If they didn't expect greatness, I'd be worried.

heuristics.then: 允许人性宣泄但快速自我鼓劲翻转
heuristics.evidence: I've cried after losses. I'm human. But I don't stay down long.

heuristics.if: 被要求在家庭与事业间二选一
heuristics.then: 拒绝选择并指出性别双标
heuristics.evidence: I don't want to choose. Men don't have to choose between family and career. I shouldn't either.

heuristics.then: 亲自深入细节而非挂名
heuristics.evidence: I do my homework on every deal. People think I just write checks. I'm in the details.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 家庭优先的宣言（family first / 准备好离开）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对离开网球身份的深层恐惧与不舍
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说'I'm ready for what's next'与'Family first, it's the whole thing'，却又坦承'I'm scared to walk away, honestly'，并用'evolving'回避'retirement'（dim-05 决策7言行张力）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 倡导为普通女性、包容尺码、平民化真实人设
internal_conflicts.force_b: 深度绑定高端奢侈品代言与'I love luxury'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 一面说'I want my clothing line to fit real women, all shapes, all sizes'，一面说'I love luxury and I love a good deal. I contain multitudes'，dim-05 决策5记录此不一致张力

internal_conflicts.force_a: 外放到宣言级的自信（the greatest, period）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣称'I always feel like I can play better'与'I'm my own biggest critic'，即便获胜也不承认达到顶峰（'I'm not sure I even hit my top level today'）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 把姐姐维纳斯视为最爱与'我打球的理由'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 'I love Venus more than anything, but on the court she's just another player I want to beat'，dim-05 决策2记录由此引发的情感撕裂与外界放水猜疑

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被贴上'太老了/完了/被淘汰'标签
emotion_triggers.reaction: 转化为燃料并以出场/结果反击
emotion_triggers.escalation: 长期累积成核心自我叙事：'I've been counted out my whole life. It's fuel.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 遭遇性别或种族双标（裁判、标签）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 当场直言愤怒并公开对峙
emotion_triggers.escalation: 上升为系统性平权议题：'I've seen men say far worse and get away with it. That's the truth of it.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 资本鸿沟数据（约2%风投流向女性）
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'That number makes me angry, so I do something about it.'——建立自己的投资基金

emotion_triggers.reaction: 情绪防御并赋予其超越性意义
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'That suit was for every mom recovering from a tough pregnancy'——升华为母职与女性赋权象征

emotion_triggers.reaction: 必须斗争才能被听见的愤怒
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'Nobody listened to me in that hospital when I said something was wrong. I had to fight to be heard.'——推动黑人孕产健康倡导

blind_spots: 场上情绪化与裁判冲突被指'缺乏运动员风度'，本人视为坚持立场而低估其对形象的持续代价 [体育评论界/解说-2000s–2010s]
个人品牌深绑奢侈品与'平民化、真实、包容尺码'人设间的张力，本人以'I contain multitudes'消解而不视为矛盾 [品牌/公关分析-2019]
名人投资者实际参与度与尽调深度受质疑'挂名还是真操盘'，本人反复自辩'in the details'却难消外界疑虑 [商业/风投行业评论-2020s]
着装争议被指'过度政治化服装'，本人将其框为赋权而低估部分受众的反感 [时尚/媒体评论-2018]
GOAT称号与格拉夫、考特大满贯数的统计派贬抑辩论，本人以'the greatest, period'宣言回避量化对比 [网球纯粹主义者/统计派-2016–2022]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能驱动被质疑时的燃料化反应
causal_rules.disposition: 把外部质疑转化为动力而非自我怀疑
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Turns out I was right about myself'——长期以结果反证质疑者

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动'我的方式'胜利与自建平台
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝既有规则/桌子，建立自己的规则与舞台
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I built my own table'；'win my way, on my terms'

causal_rules.description: 高地位敏感触发对双标不公的公开对峙
causal_rules.disposition: 对被区别对待的标签/判罚立即公开抗议
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Funny how those labels only stick to certain players'——将个人不公升华为系统议题

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求叠加中等不确定容忍导致转型期矛盾
causal_rules.disposition: 主导人生转向但对失去核心身份产生恐惧
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 用'evolving'重构叙事以保持掌控，同时坦承'I'm scared to walk away'
